I'm agnostic towards the two, I think they both have their strengths and weaknesses. Diablo III isn't quite as deep as PoE, but the end game grind is more enjoyable (to me anyway). I like the PoE content better in general when I'm working up to the end game.

My main beef with PoE is it's completely possible to create a character that tops out around level 40 and you're fucked. Also, with PoE you HAVE to have the right set of gear to get into those final few levels. Diablo seems to be more forgiving about gear.

If PoE had a way to reset character builds, IMHO it'd be a clear winner over Diablo. But the risk of putting 30 hours into a character and finding out it doesn't work hurts.
